name: Pancreatic endocrine development and incretin-driven insulin secretion
rationale: Members cover pancreatic progenitor lineages, endocrine/neuroendocrine differentiation and beta-cell function; unlike C1-C3 the theme includes insulin processing and GLP-1/GIP incretin control of insulin secretion, and unlike C4 it includes islet development.

name: Organic ion transport of monocarboxylates and TCA intermediates
rationale: Members are solute-carrier transport of organic anions and cations, centred on lactate/pyruvate (MCT, basigin) and di/tricarboxylates (succinate, alpha-ketoglutarate, malate-aspartate shuttle), which the carnitine, choline and amino-acid confusables lack.

name: Nucleosome assembly with centromeric CENP-A deposition
rationale: All members concern assembling nucleosomes and loading proteins onto chromatin, notably CENP-A deposition at centromeres, distinguishing it from chromatin remodelling (C1), condensation (C2, C4) and acetylation (C3).

qualifier: GABA and choline uptake, vesicle loading
name: Neurotransmitter transport: GABA and choline uptake, vesicle loading
rationale: Members are solute-carrier uptake of GABA and choline (SLC5A7) plus synaptic vesicle loading and acidification, whereas confusables cover glutamate/GABA metabolism, monoamine uptake, or cholinergic transmission without the transporters.

qualifier: dendritic cell chemotaxis, Cdc42 and PLC/PKC
name: Lymphocyte homing and dendritic cell chemotactic signalling
rationale: The four members describe homing adhesion and myeloid dendritic cell chemotaxis with Cdc42 and PLC/PKC signal transduction, contrasting with T cell synapse (C1), chemokine-receptor binding (C2, C3) and lymphoid organ/S1P migration (C4) confusables.

core: NK and cytotoxic T cell cytotoxicity
name: NK and CD8 T cell cytotoxic activation
rationale: Members are NK and T cell signatures and positive regulation of NK/T cell cytotoxicity, granzyme killing and CD8 proliferation, whereas confusables emphasise KIR receptors, negative regulation and tolerance.

name: Glucose-sensing ChREBP transcriptional activation
rationale: All members describe transcriptional activation by glucose/carbon source via ChREBP and PP2A dephosphorylation, distinct from lipid nuclear receptor (C1-C3) and PKA/AMPK inhibitory (C4) confusables.

name: ER quality control: protein retention, exit and retrotranslocation
rationale: Members cover ER retention, regulated ER exit, demannosylation, UFMylation and ERAD retrotranslocation to cytosol, whereas confusables concern ER targeting/insertion and COPII export.

name: Positive and negative regulation of p53 DNA-damage apoptosis
rationale: All members regulate p53-mediated DNA damage signalling and intrinsic apoptosis in both directions, unlike confusables listing TP53 transcriptional targets or senescence.

name: Cardiomyocyte membrane organization: caveolae, integrin adhesion, gap junctions
rationale: Members cover cardiomyocyte T-tubules, rafts/caveolae, ILK-PINCH-parvin focal adhesions, gap junctions and action potential control, whereas confusables concern sarcomeric contraction and desmosomes.

name: Thyroid hormone signalling, selenium metabolism and peroxide regulation
rationale: Members span thyroid hormone generation and action, selenium metabolism and selenocysteine incorporation, and H2O2 production, distinguishing it from iodide/sulfate transport (C1, C3), ROS detoxification (C2) and vitamin C (C4).

name: Chylomicron and VLDL particle assembly
rationale: All members describe assembly of triglyceride-carrying chylomicrons and VLDL, whereas confusables concern lipoprotein remodelling and clearance.

qualifier: mucin-type O-glycans and blood group antigens
name: Mucin-type O-glycan and blood group antigen biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover GalNAc O-glycosylation, antenna elongation, sialylation and fucosylation building ABO/Lewis and selectin-ligand epitopes, distinct from sulfation (C1, C3) and N-glycan trimming/sialic acid metabolism (C2, C4).

name: CBL- and SRC-mediated regulation of FLT3 signalling
rationale: All four members concern FLT3 signal propagation and attenuation through CBL and SRC kinases, whereas confusables are TKI-resistant FLT3 mutants or RUNX transcription.

name: Mammary gland and placental trophoblast development
rationale: Members cover mammary lineages, branching and lactation together with trophoblast, labyrinth and decidual development, distinguishing it from early embryo (C2) and prostate (C3, C4) confusables.

name: RAC and CDC42 GTPase cycles driving Arp2/3 lamellipodia
rationale: Members are RAC1-3, RHOG, RHOJ and CDC42 GTPase cycles signalling via WASP/WAVE to Arp2/3 and lamellipodia, versus RHOA/B/C formin-linked confusables.

name: Ubiquitin-dependent endocytic downregulation of growth factor receptors
rationale: Members describe ubiquitin-driven clathrin endocytosis and lysosomal sorting that terminate EGFR and related receptor signalling, unlike MET/PTK6 signalling (C1) or ESCRT budding (C2-C4) confusables.

name: Intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct and ureteric bud induction
rationale: Members trace kidney origin from intermediate mesoderm to nephric duct and ureteric bud formation/branching, unlike confusables focused on later nephron or ureter morphogenesis.

qualifier: haematopoietic cytokines, growth hormone and prolactin
name: JAK-STAT5 signalling by haematopoietic cytokines, growth hormone, prolactin
rationale: Members are STAT5/STAT3-coupled receptors for IL-2/3/5/7/9, IL-6 family, EPO, TPO, GH, prolactin and leptin plus oncogenic FLT3/PDGFR fusions, while confusables cover IL-10/12/15/21/23/27 and Th2/mast cell immunity.

name: T cell immunological synapse and heterotypic adhesion
rationale: Members cover T cell synapse formation, raft localization, polarity and heterotypic/PECAM1 adhesion, distinguishing it from CORO1A-DEF6 signalling (C1, C2) and integrin activation (C3, C4) confusables.

name: Integrin activation and heterotypic cell-cell adhesion
rationale: All members promote integrin activation and integrin/PECAM1-mediated heterotypic adhesion, unlike synapse (C1, C2), endothelial extravasation (C3) and integrin-MAPK signalling (C4) confusables.

name: Nutrient and energy sensing upstream of mTORC1
rationale: Members regulate mTORC1 in response to leucine/amino acids, glucose starvation and LKB1-AMPK energy status, unlike confusables on metabolic gene targets, amino-acid transport or AKT-FOXO.

name: Lipoprotein clearance, remodelling and receptor-mediated cholesterol uptake
rationale: Members cover LDL/VLDL/chylomicron clearance, HDL/LDL remodelling and cholesterol import, whereas confusables emphasise intestinal assembly/absorption and lipase activity.

name: Centrosome maturation, positioning and microtubule nucleation in mitosis
rationale: Members cover mitotic centrosome protein recruitment, centrosome location, microtubule nucleation/anchoring and spindle assembly, unlike APC/C mitotic progression (C1, C2) and spindle orientation/cilia (C3, C4) confusables.

name: Circadian transcriptional control of sleep and beta-cell proliferation
rationale: Members link CLOCK/BMAL1, NPAS4 and FOXO transcription to sleep-wake cycles, locomotor rhythm and beta-cell proliferation, whereas confusables concern orexin feeding behaviour or gluconeogenesis.
